<thought>Based on the high‑intensity ESI peak at m/z 235.1395, the ion is most consistent with a protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The formula C₁₄H₁₈O₃ matches this mass within a few ppm, making it the best candidate.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
